svg.title: Nillkin Cube Pocket key layout before and after remapping
svg.desc: Nillkin Cube Pocket physical key remapping: caps lock becomes control; left control becomes option; left option becomes command; left command becomes 英数 (eisu / LANG2); right command becomes かな (kana / LANG1); right option becomes command. Fn combinations follow the emitted usage: fn+Command (left) toggles touchpad/numpad and fn+Command (right) shows battery level, so after remapping they are on the physical option keys.
svg.text: fn combos follow the key's output, so they move with Command / Control
